decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays before the outbuilding (garage and office) is occupied

Condition : 4 - NON -STD

The detached outbuilding hereby approved shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the single-family dwellinghouse known as 79 Swift Road and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling and should not include toilet, bathroom or kitchen facilities).
description: Erection of a detached building in rear end of garden with access from Devonshire Road for use as a garage and office to the existing house.
